verdict.rationale: DPMA runs public web portals (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister, DPMAdirektWeb) and ships downloadable filing software (DPMAdirektPro), so opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for it. However, nothing in the evidence mentions telemetry, analytics, cookie consent or tracking opt-out. The robots.txt probe only covers crawler access, not user tracking, so it is irrelevant here.
